integrity: The accompanying proof states the exhaustive search domain; source programs and embedded byte hashes permit reproduction. Numerical data are exact finite enumerations, not extrapolated infinite claims.
scientific_limitations: The structural criterion is proved for every two-factor rook graph with factors of order at least two. The enumerated 4-by-4 polynomial, comparison with weak 2-resolution, and symmetry-orbit census are finite and independently reproducible within the supplied scripts; no general formula for arbitrary-size minima or counts is asserted. Priority and correctness have not been independently audited.
title: Component cuts and total metric resolution in rectangular rook graphs
